evidence.notes: Instance contains checks substring presence.
Instance endsWith checks suffix presence.
Instance equalsIgnoreCase compares without case sensitivity.
Instance indexOf finds a substring from the start.
Instance indexOf finds a substring from an offset.
Instance indexOfChar finds a Unicode code point.
Instance indexOfChar finds a Unicode code point from an offset.
Instance indexOfIgnoreCase finds a substring without case sensitivity.
Instance indexOfIgnoreCase finds a substring from an offset without case sensitivity.
Static isBlank treats null and whitespace as blank.
Static isEmpty treats the empty string as empty.
Static isNotBlank is false for whitespace.
Static isNotEmpty is true for non-empty text.
Static join renders list items with a separator.
Static format substitutes indexed list arguments.
Static getCommonPrefix returns the shared prefix across strings.
Instance Levenshtein distance compares to another string.
Instance Levenshtein distance honors a threshold.
Static fromCharArray builds text from code points.
Static escapeSingleQuotes escapes apostrophes.
